An '''Unidentified Imperial Helmsman''' piloted a [[Troop/Legends|troop]]-carrying [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmer]] for the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Sariss]], [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]] and [[Yun]] during the [[Mission to Dorlo]]. With the help of Maw's ability to [[Force sense/Legends|detect the fear of others]], the [[Helm officer/Legends|Helmsman]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the skimmer to the location of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]], whom the Dark Jedi planned to ambush and [[Prisoner/Legends|capture]]. Yet, thanks to an ambush caused by Qu Rahn's ally [[Cee Norley]], the Helmsman's skimmer crashed.<ref name="DFRA" /> While the three Dark Jedi were largely unscathed, the Helmsman was left with a grievous head injury; rather than treating his injuries and risk losing Qu Rahn, Sariss killed the Helmsman instead.<ref name="DFRAA" />
[[File:Battleofdorloland.jpg|thumb|left|80px|Imperial Helmsman's skimmer crashes]]
